Block D PRIMARY verdict, fixed before the remaining descriptive/sealed readings: **A.1's prescribed fair-test flag passes for two screen-free development candidates**, not a completed biological discovery. Pool exited0, all234 original eligible rows tested at999replicates,23cross-source prediction duplicates →211unique; partial=false,untested=[],no resolution warning. Original270plugins and stage1/stage2 are unchanged; no rerun.

- r0 `train_delta_transfer_similarity_e267` (EXP_0267): gain0.0541926002051741 ± SE_adj0.0122281535054727, pooled gene FWERp=.001, non-proportional; all six ordered-seed-pair coefficients positive. Pre-fit plan023/proposal predicts positive, matching the fit.
- r3 `gene_set_similarity_transfer_e177` (EXP_0177): gain0.0562773525677906 ± SE_adj0.0127837831799281, pooled gene FWERp=.001, non-proportional; all six coefficients positive. Pre-fit plan014/proposal says predicted_sign='unknown', so no pre-registered direction match is claimed.

Independent audit3269assertions reconstructs raw null p/moments, within-source Holm/FWER, both applicable pooled null corrections, all fixed gates and coefficient means/signs. Gene null234rows; perturbation null5 applicable unique rows, all999finite gains. The two found rows are non-proportional and therefore require the gene null only. Coefficients are six ordered seed-pair reports, not six independent runs.

Both features transfer fold-specific public training deltas via target gene-set similarity (cosine/Jaccard), with mean-response fallback. They use existing inputs; neither is in the below-threshold `new_input_features` subset. The explicit unread-input secondary subset retains full-family p-values and finds none. No replication/fresh-test/wet-lab/novelty claim, no model promotion; lead decides later criteria and next block.

Completing the authorized free sequence in own clone atnice19: nine-run OOF reading3 running, then descriptive5, then three separate sealed4 calls last. Results will update existing [PR81](https://github.com/andresloak100/Gene-Mila/pull/81). No paid run.
